title: 美股盘前：纳指期货跌0.63%，QCOM与数据中心链承压；APP逆势大涨
summary: 截至05:04 ET，道指期货涨0.48%、标普500期货近乎持平、纳指100期货跌0.63%；QCOM盘前跌10.1%，芯片与数据中心链延续压力，APP因业绩超预期涨16.4%。油价小幅反弹而10年期美债收益率回落，今晚NET、TEAM、DBX财报将检验软件估值。

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美国中期选举后风险资产反弹、油价急跌
民主党赢得国会两院后，政治不确定性下降，标普500、纳指和道指分别收涨1.58%、1.44%和3.04%；Brent跌8.7%至94.62美元。油价回落缓解运输和下游成本，但AI监管与中东谈判仍会制造波动。来源：Reuters转载、Reuters。
排行
贵金属领涨，能源、电气设备与独立电力领跌
11月4日美股现金时段，白银+10.19%、黄金+8.98%、其他贵金属+8.54%；油气炼制-6.09%、油气钻探-7.23%、电气设备-8.61%、独立电力-9.06%。A/H贵金属映射偏强，但电网订单需面对海外行业负反馈。来源：GitHub Actions/Moomoo快照，08:36 CST。
政策
逆回购与回购增持再贷款共同托底
人民银行11月5日开展3000亿元、3个月期买断式逆回购；此前又将股票回购增持再贷款利率下调至1%，座谈会后银行报送申请超过2000亿元。两项工具共同强化流动性与市值管理支持，但不等于所有题材同步受益。来源：新华财经、中国证监会。
政策
消费基础设施指导意见覆盖充电、冷链和数字化
五部门指导意见要求补齐停车与充电设施、冷链物流、智慧商圈和消费终端数字化等短板，并引导政策性金融工具、REITs与社会资本参与。利好充电、电网、冷链和数字商业设施，但项目落地和回报周期需核验。来源：国家发展改革委。
政策
数据要素与人工智能用数治理继续推进
国家数据局提出建设全国一体化数据市场、推进新一轮“数据要素×”行动，并研究AI用数安全与合规指引。对数据基础设施、行业数据服务和AI应用是中期支撑，短期仍以真实订单和价格确认为准。来源：国家数据局。
产业
5G+工业互联网大会聚焦AI融合赋能
2026中国5G+工业互联网大会将于11月18日至20日在武汉举行，聚焦人工智能融合赋能并计划发布相关成果。事件提升工业互联网与通信设备关注度，但会议预期不能替代公司订单。来源：人民邮电报转载。
市场
港股科技强势领涨，A股维持分化上行
10:05公开延迟行情显示上证3691.29点、涨0.14%，创业板2589.32点、涨1.75%；恒指24619.80点、涨2.93%，恒生科技4120.80点、涨4.69%。港股科技显著领涨，确认风险偏好修复；A股则以成长强于大盘的分化上行为主。来源：东方财富公开延迟行情。
公告
林洋能源中标国家电网项目约1.99亿元
公司收到智能电表、采集终端等7个标包及智能融合终端中标通知，合计约1.988亿元，占2025年营收4.08%；尚未签正式合同。11月4日收盘5.70元、涨4.40%，价格早于盘后公告。来源：公司公告转录。
公告
友讯达中标国家电网项目约1.96亿元
公司合计中10个包，金额约1.956亿元，占2025年营收24.56%；合同尚未正式签署。11月4日收盘8.87元、涨0.68%，而前三季度归母净利润仍亏损411.6万元，催化与盈利质量并存冲突。来源：公司公告转录。
公告
统一股份与宁德时代签署冷却液战略合作
双方拟开展冷却液全生命周期、可靠性和汽车后市场合作，但协议没有采购量、金额、最低采购义务，对本年度业绩预计不构成重大影响。公司11月4日收盘18.18元、跌6.86%，且单三季度亏损487.98万元。来源：公司公告转录。
确认
汽车之家港股涨8.02%，双市场确认分红催化
汽车之家三季度收入与利润同比下降，但宣布每ADS 1.58美元特别股息后ADR上涨12.63%；10:05港股报42.04港元、涨8.02%，较前收38.92港元再获本地市场确认。收入与利润下滑仍限制持续性。来源：公司IR、东方财富公开延迟行情。
产业
国家电网智能计量订单集中落地
除林洋与友讯达外，炬华科技亦披露约2.36亿元中标，显示智能电表和融合终端采购进入兑现期。订单利好本地设备链，但隔夜美股电气设备行业跌8.61%，今日只能做公司级确认而非板块追涨。来源：炬华科技公告转录。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
三大ETF代理保持普涨
运行时公开报价截至08:21-08:23 CST：QQQ 691.95美元、较前收+0.96%；SPY 766.81美元、+1.63%；DIA 533.11美元、+3.09%。三者是延长时段ETF代理，涨跌为相对前收的累计变化，数据源未拆分收盘后单独增量。
板块对照
贵金属与概念强势获确认，弱势行业代表股分化
行业Top5代表股NEWP +14.67%、NAMM +12.92%、HL +13.17%、LDI +15.19%、ADV +35.09%，均确认正向。Bottom5中BORR -3.90%确认油气钻探弱势；AIOK +11.31%、OFAL +12.34%、ZOOZ +14.72%、ONEN +6.62%与所属负向行业相反，属于个股背离/潜在反转。概念Top5的MOS +17.32%、HL +13.17%、OUST +15.73%、DFDV +14.42%、CCL +7.23%均确认正向。报价时间跨06:35-08:23 CST。
A/H 映射
港股科技与汽车之家获确认，电网催化仍分化
恒生科技涨4.69%确认港股科技风险偏好，汽车之家港股涨8.02%确认ADR与分红催化；友讯达涨2.25%仅略强于创业板，林洋能源持平，电网订单仍不足以转为普遍多头。贵金属延续性观察保留，统一股份虽涨3.52%但框架协议缺少金额与采购量，继续回避。

盘中结论

10:05恒生科技涨4.69%、恒指涨2.93%，叠加回购增持再贷款与逆回购工具，港股科技风险偏好和政策流动性托底均获确认；创业板涨1.75%，A股成长也强于大盘。

电网订单映射仍分化：友讯达仅略强于创业板、林洋能源持平；统一股份虽反弹，但框架协议仍缺少采购量、金额与盈利兑现证据。

汽车之家港股涨8.02%并与ADR正反馈一致，升级为多头候选；林洋能源、友讯达维持条件关注，统一股份继续回避。贵金属强势仍缺少新的公司级催化，不追涨硬凑候选。

重点个股关注

林洋能源
601222.SH
条件关注

事实与状态：国家电网中标约1.99亿元，但10:05报5.70元、涨跌0%，弱于创业板和港股科技，尚无明确价格确认。

确认条件：正式合同推进、股价站上盘中高点5.73元并持续强于电网设备板块。

风险与失效：隔夜电气设备及独立电力行业大跌，项目交付与利润率仍不确定；跌破5.50元盘中低点即降级。

友讯达
300514.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：中标约1.96亿元、占2025年营收24.56%；10:05报9.07元、涨2.25%，仅略强于创业板1.75%，确认强度仍有限。

确认条件：正式合同签署并保持在9.09元盘中高点附近，且相对创业板与电网设备继续扩大领先。

风险与失效：合同尚未签署、年内净利润为负；跌回前收8.87元下方即失效。

汽车之家-S
02518.HK / ATHM
多头候选

事实与状态：每ADS 1.58美元特别股息推动ADR涨12.63%；10:05港股报42.04港元、涨8.02%，双市场正反馈确认分红催化。

确认条件：维持在前收38.92港元上方，并在港股科技强势中不出现显著相对转弱。

风险与失效：三季度收入与利润同比下降，催化偏股东回报而非经营反转；跌回前收下方或放量弱于恒科即降级。

统一股份
600506.SH
回避

事实与状态：10:05报18.82元、涨3.52%，但与宁德时代的合作仅为冷却液研究框架，未披露采购量、合同金额或收入承诺。

确认条件：只有出现明确订单、金额、交付计划与盈利贡献，并获得持续价格确认后才重新评估。

风险与失效：前一日跌6.86%、隔夜油气炼制板块跌6.09%；单日反弹不能替代商业兑现证据。

板块轮动看板

受益方向港股科技、平台经济与高股息互联网；政策流动性与强势恒科共振
观察方向创业板成长、电网智能计量与贵金属；需继续比较相对强度和公司催化
压力方向油气炼制、独立电力及缺少订单金额的概念合作
验证信号恒科守住前收并维持领先；汽车之家守住38.92港元，友讯达扩大对创业板领先

逻辑链

回购增持再贷款降至1% + 3000亿元逆回购 → 流动性与市值管理支持增强 → A/H风险偏好获政策托底。
恒科+4.69%、恒指+2.93% → 港股科技领涨而非被动跟随 → 平台与互联网板块判断上修。
汽车之家ADR+12.63% + 港股+8.02% → 特别股息获双市场确认 → 升为多头候选但非经营反转。
友讯达+2.25%、林洋持平 → 电网订单只获有限确认 → 保持条件关注而不做板块化看多。
统一股份+3.52%但框架无金额/采购量 → 价格反弹不足以补齐商业证据 → 继续回避。

风险雷达

涨幅集中恒科显著强于上证，若午后领涨收窄，港股科技修复可能快速降温。
电网兑现友讯达与林洋项目尚需合同、交付和利润率兑现，当前价格确认有限。
经营下滑汽车之家收入与利润同比下降，分红催化不等于基本面反转。
概念合作统一股份协议未披露采购量和金额，存在情绪交易回落风险。
数据时效10:05为公开延迟行情；AKShare仍为11月4日14:23盘中历史快照。

数据来源与时间点

首轮研究截止2026-11-05 08:40 CST；09:15增量复核公开延迟行情抓取于10:05 CST：上证+0.14%、创业板+1.75%、恒指+2.93%、恒科+4.69%，林洋能源0%、友讯达+2.25%、汽车之家-S +8.02%、统一股份+3.52%。遗漏核验补入回购增持再贷款利率降至1%及银行申请超过2000亿元；未发现08:40后足以改变判断的新增重大交易所公告。首轮法定来源、Reuters及GitHub Actions/Moomoo 09:28快照继续有效。AKShare v1.18.94 fetchedAt 2026-11-04 14:23:57 CST，仅作11月4日盘中历史基线。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not price change.
Major News Digest
Global
Risk assets rally and oil tumbles after US midterms
After Democrats won both chambers of Congress, political uncertainty eased; the S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow rose 1.58%, 1.44% and 3.04%. Brent fell 8.7% to $94.62. Lower oil helps transport and downstream costs, while AI regulation and Iran talks remain volatility risks. Sources: Reuters mirror and Reuters.
Ranking
Precious metals lead; energy and electrical equipment lag
In the Nov 4 US cash session, silver rose 10.19%, gold 8.98% and other precious metals 8.54%. Refining fell 6.09%, drilling 7.23%, electrical equipment 8.61% and independent power 9.06%. A/H precious metals map positively, but local grid awards face overseas sector pressure. Source: GitHub Actions/Moomoo snapshot at 08:36 CST.
Policy
Reverse repo and buyback relending jointly support equities
The PBOC scheduled a CNY300 billion three-month outright reverse repo for Nov 5 and had cut buyback/holding-increase relending to 1%, with bank applications exceeding CNY200 billion after the meeting. The tools strengthen liquidity and corporate market-value support but do not lift every theme. Sources: Xinhua Finance and the CSRC.
Policy
Consumption-infrastructure guidance covers charging, cold chain and digitization
Five ministries called for upgrades to parking and charging networks, cold-chain logistics, smart commercial districts and digital consumption terminals, with policy finance, REITs and private capital participation. Projects and return cycles still require verification. Source: NDRC.
Policy
Data-element and AI data-governance plans advance
The National Data Administration proposed an integrated national data market, a new Data Elements Plus program and AI-data compliance guidance. This supports data infrastructure and industry-data services over the medium term, but near-term trades still need orders and price confirmation. Source: NDA.
Industry
5G + Industrial Internet conference focuses on AI enablement
The 2026 China 5G + Industrial Internet Conference will be held in Wuhan on Nov 18-20 and plans to release AI-integration results. This lifts attention to industrial internet and telecom equipment, but conference expectations do not replace company orders. Source: People's Posts and Telecommunications News mirror.
Market
Hong Kong tech leads while A-shares rise unevenly
At 10:05 delayed quotes showed Shanghai at 3691.29 (+0.14%), ChiNext 2589.32 (+1.75%), Hang Seng 24619.80 (+2.93%) and HSTECH 4120.80 (+4.69%). Hong Kong tech decisively led the risk-on move, while A-shares advanced with growth outperforming the broad market. Source: Eastmoney delayed quotes.
Filing
Linyang wins about CNY199 million of State Grid projects
The company received awards for seven smart-meter and collection-terminal packages plus an intelligent terminal package, totaling CNY198.834 million or 4.08% of 2025 revenue; formal contracts are unsigned. The Nov 4 close was CNY5.70, up 4.40%, before the after-hours filing. Source: filing transcript.
Filing
Youxunda wins about CNY196 million of State Grid projects
The company won ten packages totaling CNY195.616 million, or 24.56% of 2025 revenue; contracts remain unsigned. The Nov 4 close was CNY8.87, up 0.68%, while nine-month attributable profit was still a CNY4.12 million loss. Source: filing transcript.
Filing
Tongyi signs a coolant cooperation framework with CATL
The parties plan lifecycle, reliability and aftermarket cooperation, but the framework has no purchase volume, value or minimum commitment and is not expected to materially affect this year's results. The stock closed Nov 4 at CNY18.18, down 6.86%, while Q3 alone recorded a CNY4.88 million loss. Source: filing transcript.
Confirmed
Autohome gains 8.02% in Hong Kong, confirming the dividend catalyst
Revenue and profit declined year over year, but the US$1.58-per-ADS special dividend sent the ADR up 12.63%. At 10:05 the Hong Kong share traded at HKD42.04, up 8.02% from HKD38.92, adding local-market confirmation. Falling earnings still limit durability. Sources: company IR and Eastmoney delayed quotes.
Industry
State Grid smart-meter awards arrive in a cluster
Beyond Linyang and Youxunda, Juhua disclosed about CNY236 million of awards, confirming procurement momentum in smart meters and integrated terminals. The local order cycle is positive, but US electrical equipment fell 8.61%, so today's setup requires company-level confirmation rather than a sector chase. Source: Juhua filing transcript.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indexes
Three ETF proxies remain broadly positive
Runtime public quotes at 08:21-08:23 CST: QQQ $691.95, +0.96% versus the prior close; SPY $766.81, +1.63%; DIA $533.11, +3.09%. These are extended-hours ETF proxies with cumulative changes versus the prior close; the source does not isolate a standalone post-close leg.
Sector Check
Precious metals and concepts confirm; weak-industry leaders diverge
Industry Top5 leaders NEWP +14.67%, NAMM +12.92%, HL +13.17%, LDI +15.19% and ADV +35.09% confirm positive direction. In Bottom5, BORR -3.90% confirms drilling weakness; AIOK +11.31%, OFAL +12.34%, ZOOZ +14.72% and ONEN +6.62% oppose their negative industries, signaling stock-level divergence/potential reversal. Concept leaders MOS +17.32%, HL +13.17%, OUST +15.73%, DFDV +14.42% and CCL +7.23% all confirm positive direction. Quote times span 06:35-08:23 CST.
A/H Mapping
Hong Kong tech and Autohome confirm; grid catalysts remain mixed
HSTECH's 4.69% gain confirms Hong Kong tech risk appetite, while Autohome's 8.02% Hong Kong rise confirms the ADR/dividend catalyst. Youxunda at +2.25% only modestly beat ChiNext and Linyang was flat, so grid awards do not justify a broad bullish call. Tongyi gained 3.52%, but the framework still lacks purchase volume and value and remains an avoid.

Intraday Conclusion

At 10:05 HSTECH gained 4.69% and the Hang Seng 2.93%; together with buyback relending and outright reverse repo support, Hong Kong tech risk appetite and policy liquidity were confirmed. ChiNext rose 1.75%, also leading broad A-shares.

Grid-award mapping stayed mixed: Youxunda only modestly beat ChiNext and Linyang was flat. Tongyi rebounded, but its framework still lacks purchase volume, value and earnings evidence.

Autohome's 8.02% Hong Kong gain confirmed the ADR/dividend reaction and upgrades it to a bullish candidate. Linyang and Youxunda stay conditional watches; Tongyi remains an avoid. Precious metals still lack a fresh company catalyst.

Key Stocks

Linyang Energy
601222.SH
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: The State Grid award is about CNY199 million, but at 10:05 the stock was flat at CNY5.70, lagging ChiNext and Hong Kong tech, so price confirmation is absent.

Confirmation: Formal contract progress, a move above the CNY5.73 intraday high and sustained outperformance versus grid equipment.

Risk and invalidation: Overnight electrical equipment and independent power fell sharply; delivery and margins remain uncertain. A break below CNY5.50 triggers a downgrade.

Youxunda
300514.SZ
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: The CNY196 million award equals 24.56% of 2025 revenue. At 10:05 the stock was CNY9.07, up 2.25%, only modestly ahead of ChiNext's 1.75% gain.

Confirmation: Sign the formal contract, stay near the CNY9.09 intraday high and extend relative strength versus ChiNext and grid equipment.

Risk and invalidation: The contract is unsigned and year-to-date net profit is negative. A break below the CNY8.87 prior close invalidates the setup.

Autohome-S
02518.HK / ATHM
Bullish Candidate

Facts and status: A US$1.58-per-ADS special dividend sent the ADR up 12.63%; at 10:05 the Hong Kong share was HKD42.04, up 8.02%, confirming the catalyst in both markets.

Confirmation: Hold above the HKD38.92 prior close and avoid marked relative weakness while Hong Kong tech remains strong.

Risk and invalidation: Q3 revenue and profit declined; this is shareholder-return support, not an operating turnaround. A break below the prior close or heavy underperformance triggers a downgrade.

Tongyi
600506.SH
Avoid

Facts and status: At 10:05 the stock was CNY18.82, up 3.52%, but the CATL cooperation is a coolant-research framework with no disclosed purchase volume, contract value or revenue commitment.

Confirmation: Reassess only after concrete orders, value, delivery and earnings contribution appear with sustained price confirmation.

Risk and invalidation: The stock fell 6.86% the prior day and US refining fell 6.09%; one rebound cannot replace commercial evidence.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesHong Kong tech, platforms and high-dividend internet; policy liquidity aligns with HSTECH strength
WatchChiNext growth, smart metering and precious metals; require relative-strength and company-catalyst checks
PressureRefining, independent power and concept partnerships without concrete order value
ValidationHSTECH holds its prior close and lead; Autohome holds HKD38.92; Youxunda extends its ChiNext lead

Logic Chain

Buyback relending at 1% + CNY300 billion reverse repo → stronger liquidity and market-value support → policy floor for A/H risk appetite.
HSTECH +4.69% and Hang Seng +2.93% → Hong Kong tech leads rather than follows → platform/internet view upgraded.
Autohome ADR +12.63% + Hong Kong +8.02% → dividend confirmed in both markets → bullish candidate, not an operating turnaround.
Youxunda +2.25% and Linyang flat → only limited grid-award confirmation → conditional watches, not a sector-wide bullish call.
Tongyi +3.52% but no framework value/volume → rebound cannot fill the commercial-evidence gap → remain avoid.

Risk Radar

Concentrated gainsHSTECH materially leads Shanghai; a narrowing lead could cool the repair quickly.
Grid executionYouxunda and Linyang still need contracts, delivery and margin realization; confirmation is limited.
Operating declineAutohome revenue and profit fell; the dividend catalyst is not a fundamental turnaround.
Concept partnershipTongyi disclosed no purchase volume or value, leaving sentiment-reversal risk.
Data freshness10:05 figures are public delayed quotes; AKShare remains a Nov 4 14:23 historical intraday snapshot.

Sources and Timestamps

Public delayed quotes for the 09:15 review were fetched at 10:05 CST: Shanghai +0.14%, ChiNext +1.75%, Hang Seng +2.93%, HSTECH +4.69%, Linyang 0%, Youxunda +2.25%, Autohome-S +8.02% and Tongyi +3.52%. Omission review added the buyback-relending rate cut to 1% and bank applications above CNY200 billion; no post-08:40 major exchange filing changed the conclusion. First-run statutory sources, Reuters and the GitHub Actions/Moomoo 09:28 snapshot remain valid. AKShare v1.18.94 fetchedAt 2026-11-04 14:23:57 CST is Nov 4 historical intraday context only.

关键资产图

道指期货

关键词云

芯片承压APP业绩QCOM暴跌数据中心放缓大盘科技抗跌SNAP失速FICO落空油价反弹收益率回落美元走弱就业前夜盘后软件财报
利多利空中性w1-w5表示热度/重要性，不代表涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
指数
期指分化：道指领涨、纳指承压
截至05:04 ET，道指期货涨0.48%、标普500期货涨0.01%、纳指100期货跌0.63%。前一日政治不确定性下降带来反弹，但科技链未延续。来源：Reuters。
财报
QCOM手机芯片展望遭市场惩罚
QCOM盘前跌10.1%，第四财季手机芯片销售预期低于市场估计，苹果相关收入下降与成本压力盖过其他亮点。负价格反馈明确，不进入多头推荐。
AI基建
数据中心延期风险继续压制产业链
UBS估计约30%的2028年预期新增数据中心容量可能受延期影响。MRVL跌2.5%、INTC跌1.7%，IREN、HUT、APLD、CORZ、CRWV、NBIS、DELL与HPE普遍走弱。
财报
APP业绩与指引均获认可
APP盘前涨16.4%，第三季度利润超预期，广告平台增长与指引缓解AI颠覆担忧。正向价格确认清晰，但高波动与估值仍需约束仓位。
财报
SNAP与FICO负反馈扩大分化
SNAP因第三季度营收不及预期跌10.1%，FICO因第四季度利润落空跌约9%。两者均列入压力观察，价格反馈优先于题材叙事。
科技
平台股因资本开支放缓预期相对抗跌
AMZN、META与GOOGL盘前各涨约0.5%。数据中心建设放缓可能缓解短期现金流压力，但长期AI算力供给也可能受限。
硬件
COHR财报提供光通信链局部支撑
COHR盘前约涨2%，财报好于预期；但数据中心延期担忧仍在，须等待开盘后相对强度与量能确认，不能外推至整个设备板块。
宏观
美元与美债收益率回落暂缓估值压力
美元指数跌0.22%至101.25，10年期美债收益率回落4.5个基点至4.847%。市场仍计入12月加息概率超过80%，周五就业报告前的缓冲可能不稳固。来源：Reuters镜像。
商品
油价在前日暴跌后温和反弹
Brent在前日跌逾8%后反弹逾1%，WTI盘前约88.50美元、涨0.4%。较低油价仍利于运输与消费成本，但供给扰动使反弹不确定。
日程
初请、联储讲话与周五非农构成催化
周四关注初请失业金、生产率与单位劳动力成本，以及多位联储官员讲话；周五十月就业报告将决定市场是否继续上调加息路径。
盘后
NET、TEAM与DBX检验软件需求
三家公司均已确认收盘后披露。NET的AI安全需求、TEAM的云迁移与DBX的盈利纪律将比单季EPS更影响估值。

盘前结论

事实：美元与10年期收益率回落，道指期货上涨，平台股相对抗跌；APP、SONY与COHR获正向财报反馈。

判断：纳指期货下跌且芯片与数据中心链同步承压，显示资金从高资本开支链条向现金流更清晰的应用和平台股轮动。

不确定性：周五就业数据、12月加息预期与软件财报可能改写利率和估值路径；必须等待现金市场确认。

重点个股推荐

AppLovin
APP
强势候选

推荐理由：第三季度利润超预期且指引获认可，盘前涨16.4%，正向价格反馈最明确。

触发因素：开盘后守住盘前缺口，并维持相对软件与广告科技板块的强势。

风险点：高估值、财报后波动与获利回吐；跌破盘前主要支撑则降级观察。

Coherent
COHR
确认后参与

推荐理由：财报好于预期，盘前约涨2%，在设备与数据中心链普跌时体现相对强度。

触发因素：开盘后继续跑赢光通信与半导体设备同业，并出现可验证成交承接。

风险点：数据中心延期可能压低订单兑现速度；量能未完整核验，不视为放量突破。

索尼集团
SONY
指引驱动

推荐理由：上调全年盈利展望后盘前约涨5%，影视与游戏内容带来清晰正反馈。

触发因素：开盘后守住指引缺口，并保持对可选消费与媒体板块的相对强势。

风险点：日元波动、内容档期与一次性电影收入可能放大季度波动。

Meta Platforms
META
相对抗跌

推荐理由：盘前约涨1%，市场将数据中心建设放缓视为短期资本开支缓冲，表现强于纳指期货。

触发因素：继续跑赢纳指100，并在收益率反弹时仍保持正反馈。

风险点：长期AI算力受限、监管变化与广告周期下行可能逆转相对优势。

板块轮动看板

强势观察APP、SONY与少数光通信股；以财报后正反馈和相对强度为准
事件驱动NET、TEAM、DBX盘后财报；重点看指引、客户增长和利润率
压力方向QCOM、SNAP、FICO及芯片、服务器、数据中心运营商
验证信号纳指期货收复跌幅、10年期收益率守在4.85%附近、APP守住缺口

逻辑链

中期选举后美元与收益率回落 → 估值压力边际缓解 → 道指与平台股获得支撑。
数据中心延期风险上升 → 芯片、服务器与算力运营商订单节奏受疑 → 纳指期货落后。
QCOM、SNAP、FICO大跌而APP大涨 → 财报价格反馈胜过题材叙事 → 个股分化优于指数追涨。
收益率回落但12月加息概率仍高 → 周五就业报告是关键验证 → 盘前波动不可视为趋势确认。

盘后财报 beat 概率

中
Cloudflare（NET）
一致预期约EPS 0.34美元、营收7.368亿美元，公司指引为EPS 0.34美元、营收7.36–7.37亿美元；上季EPS 0.29美元高于约0.27美元预期，近8季有5次EPS beat。AI安全与SASE需求、近90天全年EPS预期上修构成支撑，但高估值限制信心。概率为判断，不是确定事实。
中
Atlassian（TEAM）
一致预期约EPS 1.39美元、营收17.1亿美元；上季EPS 1.87美元高于1.50美元预期，近8季有7次EPS beat。云迁移与费用纪律有利，但企业软件采购和AI投入回报可能压制指引。概率为判断，不是确定事实。
高
Dropbox（DBX）
一致预期约EPS 0.73美元、营收6.296亿美元。公司10月28日向SEC提交初步信息，称营收、固定汇率营收与非GAAP营业利润率预计处于或高于此前指引；这提高达到公司指引的概率，但不保证高于一致预期。席位压力与增长放缓仍是风险。概率为判断，不是确定事实。

风险雷达

芯片链再定价QCOM、MRVL、INTC与数据中心股同步下跌，开盘后可能触发进一步去杠杆。
利率路径市场仍计入12月加息概率超过80%；强就业数据可能迅速推高收益率。
财报高波动NET、TEAM与DBX若指引弱于高预期，软件估值可能连锁下修。
行情时点期指为05:04 ET、宏观资产约06:10 ET公开报价，开盘前仍可能显著变化。

数据来源与时间点

行情核验时间：2026-11-05 20:29 CST（07:29 ET前）。主要来源：Reuters、公开盘前行情、公司IR与SEC文件；期指为05:04 ET，宏观资产约06:10 ET，盘前成交量并非全部可核验。

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not price change.
Major News Digest
Futures
Futures diverge as the Dow leads and Nasdaq lags
At 05:04 ET, Dow futures rose 0.48%, S&P 500 futures gained 0.01% and Nasdaq 100 futures fell 0.63%. The prior day’s political-relief rally did not carry through to technology. Source: Reuters.
Earnings
QCOM is punished for a weak smartphone-chip outlook
QCOM fell 10.1% premarket after its fourth-quarter smartphone-chip sales outlook missed estimates, while Apple-related revenue pressure and costs outweighed other positives. The negative response excludes it from bullish picks.
AI Buildout
Data-center delay risk keeps pressuring the buildout chain
UBS estimated roughly 30% of expected 2028 data-center additions could be delayed. MRVL fell 2.5%, INTC 1.7%, while IREN, HUT, APLD, CORZ, CRWV, NBIS, DELL and HPE weakened.
Earnings
APP earnings and guidance win approval
APP jumped 16.4% after third-quarter profit beat expectations and guidance eased AI-disruption concerns. Price confirmation is clear, though volatility and valuation still warrant discipline.
Earnings
SNAP and FICO widen earnings dispersion
SNAP fell 10.1% after a revenue miss, while FICO lost about 9% after profit disappointed. Both belong in pressure monitoring; price action overrides narratives.
Megacaps
Platforms hold up on slower-capex expectations
AMZN, META and GOOGL each gained about 0.5%. A slower data-center buildout may ease near-term cash-flow pressure but could also constrain long-term AI compute supply.
Hardware
COHR offers selective support for optical names
COHR gained about 2% after better-than-expected results. Data-center delay concerns persist, so post-open strength and volume must confirm the move; it should not be extrapolated to all equipment names.
Macro
A softer dollar and lower yields offer relief
The dollar index fell 0.22% to 101.25 and the 10-year yield eased 4.5 basis points to 4.847%. Markets still price more than an 80% chance of a December hike, so relief may be fragile before Friday jobs data. Source: Reuters mirror.
Commodities
Oil rebounds modestly after the prior rout
Brent rebounded more than 1% after dropping over 8%, while WTI traded near $88.50, up 0.4%. Lower oil still helps transport and consumer costs, but supply risks keep the rebound uncertain.
Calendar
Claims, Fed speakers and payrolls form the next catalyst
Thursday brings jobless claims, productivity, unit labor costs and Fed speakers. Friday’s October jobs report will determine whether markets further steepen the rate-hike path.
After Close
NET, TEAM and DBX will test software demand
All three confirmed after-close reports. NET’s AI-security demand, TEAM’s cloud migration and DBX’s profit discipline will matter more than one-quarter EPS.

Premarket Conclusion

Facts: The dollar and 10-year yield eased, Dow futures rose and platforms held up; APP, SONY and COHR received positive earnings feedback.

View: Falling Nasdaq futures and synchronized weakness in chips and data-center names point to rotation from capex-heavy chains toward applications and platforms with clearer cash flow.

Uncertainty: Friday payrolls, December-hike expectations and software earnings can reset rates and valuations; cash-session confirmation is required.

Key Stock Picks

AppLovin
APP
Bullish Candidate

Why it qualifies：Third-quarter profit beat expectations and guidance was well received; the 16.4% gain provides the clearest positive confirmation.

Trigger：Hold the premarket gap and sustain strength versus software and ad-tech peers.

Risk：Rich valuation, post-earnings volatility and profit-taking; a break of key support downgrades the setup.

Coherent
COHR
Confirm First

Why it qualifies：Results beat expectations and shares gained about 2%, showing strength while equipment peers fell.

Trigger：Continue to outperform optical and semiconductor-equipment peers with verifiable trading support.

Risk：Data-center delays may slow orders; volume is not fully verified, so this is not a high-volume breakout.

Sony Group
SONY
Guidance-Led

Why it qualifies：Shares rose about 5% after a full-year outlook increase, with film and gaming producing clear positive feedback.

Trigger：Hold the guidance-driven gap and maintain strength versus consumer and media peers.

Risk：Yen moves, release timing and one-off film revenue can amplify volatility.

Meta Platforms
META
Relative Strength

Why it qualifies：Shares gained about 1%, outperforming Nasdaq futures as slower construction was seen as capex relief.

Trigger：Keep outperforming the Nasdaq 100 and retain positive feedback if yields rebound.

Risk：Constrained AI capacity, regulation and a weaker ad cycle could reverse the edge.

Sector Rotation Board

StrengthAPP, SONY and selective optical names; require post-earnings confirmation and relative strength
Event-DrivenNET, TEAM and DBX after-close reports; focus on guidance, customer growth and margins
PressureQCOM, SNAP, FICO, chips, servers and data-center operators
ValidationNasdaq futures recover, the 10-year yield holds near 4.85%, and APP retains its gap

Logic Chain

Post-midterm declines in the dollar and yields → valuation relief → support for the Dow and platforms.
Higher data-center delay risk → order doubts for chips, servers and compute operators → Nasdaq futures lag.
QCOM, SNAP and FICO slump while APP surges → price action overrides narratives → stock selection beats index chasing.
Yields ease but December-hike odds stay high → Friday payrolls are the key test → premarket moves are not trend confirmation.

After-Hours Earnings Beat Probability

Medium
Cloudflare（NET）
Consensus is about $0.34 EPS and $736.8 million revenue, versus guidance of $0.34 and $736–737 million. Last quarter EPS of $0.29 beat roughly $0.27, with five EPS beats in eight quarters. AI security, SASE demand and upward FY EPS revisions help, but valuation caps confidence. This probability is judgment, not fact.
Medium
Atlassian（TEAM）
Consensus is about $1.39 EPS and $1.71 billion revenue. Last quarter EPS of $1.87 beat $1.50, and EPS beat in seven of eight quarters. Cloud migration and expense discipline help, but software demand and AI returns may pressure guidance. This probability is judgment, not fact.
High
Dropbox（DBX）
Consensus is about $0.73 EPS and $629.6 million revenue. An Oct. 28 SEC filing said preliminary revenue, constant-currency revenue and non-GAAP operating margin were expected in line with or above prior guidance. That raises the chance of meeting guidance but does not guarantee a consensus beat. Seat pressure and slower growth remain risks. This probability is judgment, not fact.

Risk Radar

Chip repricingQCOM, MRVL, INTC and data-center names are falling together, creating deleveraging risk.
Rate pathMarkets still price more than an 80% chance of a December hike; strong jobs data could lift yields.
Earnings volatilitySoft guidance from NET, TEAM or DBX could trigger a broader software reset.
Data timingFutures are from 05:04 ET and macro assets around 06:10 ET; prices can still move before the open.

Sources and Timestamps

Checked at 2026-11-05 20:29 CST (before 07:29 ET). Main sources: Reuters, public premarket quotes, company IR and SEC filings. Core futures are from 05:04 ET and macro assets around 06:10 ET; volume is not verifiable for every name.
